title: Croatian Rocket Soup
description: A spicy Mexican-inspired twist on a classic soup. This recipe combines the bold flavors of Croatia with the vibrant tastes of Mexico.

ingredients.name: Croatian paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds depth to the soup

ingredients.name: Rocket (arugula)
ingredients.notes: Peppery rocket adds a fresh flavor

ingredients.name: Zesty tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Diced tomatoes add a burst of flavor

ingredients.name: Vegetable broth
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium broth ensures a healthy soup

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: A healthy source of fat for sautéing

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds a punch of flavor

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin adds a warm, earthy flavor

ingredients.name: Chili powder
ingredients.notes: Adds a spicy kick to the soup

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper enhances flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, and chili powder. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Add the peppery rocket to the saucepan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until wilted.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional rocket if desired.
Enjoy as a comforting and flavorful meal!
